title: Mock exam question file
description: A question file is a JSON array of items. Every item carries its correct answer and a reason for every option, so the platform can explain why each choice is right or wrong.

id.description: Unique id, e.g. D2-API-001 (domain, skill code, number).

skill.description: Skill id from exam.json; must belong to `domain`.

difficulty.description: 1 Foundational (apply a single concept in a scenario), 2 Intermediate (applied scenario), 3 Advanced (multi-constraint tradeoff or diagnosis), 4 Expert (several defensible options; only one satisfies every stated constraint).

type.description: single = multiple choice (4 options, 1 key); multi = multiple response (5–6 options, 2–3 keys).

select.description: How many options the candidate must select; equals the number of correct options.

stem.description: The scenario and question. Multi-response stems end with "(Choose two.)" or "(Choose three.)". Supports `inline code` and ``` fenced blocks.

why.description: Why this specific option is right or wrong. Shown to the candidate on review.

explanation.description: The overall teaching point for the item.

reference.description: Official documentation page that backs the answer.
